177267.overview: Sci-fi puzzle-platformer game. Find a clone gun, create your own clones and overcome deathly traps by destroying them!

215600.overview: Henry has been captured by the government, but they've offered him a deal. If Henry can help them take down the Toppat Clan, an international group of theives, his charges will be dropped. Henry will have to find a way into their airship and figure out a way to deal with the Toppats.

215670.overview:
See how many questions you can answer before it's Game Over. Sounds simple? Think again... the questions are BASTARD hard and require obscure insane logic, super fast reactions or just pure luck to answer correctly.

It's not actually impossible though, just really really hard.

219208.overview:
Interactive Buddy is sandbox buddy-simulation game developed by Newgrounds user Shock Value. Players play with a small buddy, earning money to unlock more tools through interacting with it. Players can make it happy with tools like tickling or attack it with various weapons.

Although simple, the game became one of the most iconic Flash games of its era.

439079.overview:
Icarus Needs is an adventure game published on Kongregate on July 10, 2013.

Icarus has fallen asleep playing videogames and become trapped inside a surreal dream world that’s part videogame and part comic strip. What’s worse, somehow his girlfriend Kit has got trapped inside the same dream.

Now Icarus needs to locate Kit, escape the clutches of the King of Squirrels and find some way back to the waking world

439080.overview:
I wish I were the Moon is the first game in the Moon Stories trilogy and it is a short puzzle game inspired by Enigma's song Sitting on the Moon and the short story The Distance of the Moon from the book Cosmicomics by Italo Calvino, where sailors set out on the sea to find the place where the moon touches the water. The game is about an unusual love triangle between a boy, a girl and the moon.

At the start of the game, the girl is rowing a boat, while the boy is sitting on top of the moon above her. The entire game is played in a single, non-scrolling screen. Rather than a physical place, the author aims to present it as an emotional image. The player can control the events through a camera controlled by the mouse. When a picture is taken, whatever is depicted inside the frame can be moved somewhere else to relocate it. That way, the player can influence the people, objects and environments to find five different game endings. Discovering the endings is the aim of the game itself, there are no other goals. After completing an ending the R key can be used to rewind the setting to try something new.

As it was submitted as an entry to the Independent Game Festival 2009, in November 2008 an updated version was released with tweaked settings, two new endings and a secret ending.

439082.overview: Immortal Souls: Dark Crusade is a comic book RPG that blends elements of Final Fantasy, Puzzle Quest, and Bejeweled. It was developed by comicbookrpgs and published on Kongregate on March 16, 2012.

439083.overview: Icycle is a platform game where the protagonist, a balding naked middle aged man, is the only cryogenic success of the next ice age, the only person left. The player controls this character as he rides his BMX around a frozen earth collecting frozen soap bubbles during eight levels. He cannot back pedal, forwards or up are the only directions available, although the speed of the bike can be controlled.

439084.overview: IndestructoTank! is a flash game in which the player takes control of a indestructible tank. The tank drives along the bottom of the screen while enemy aircraft fire on it from above. It has no weapons for it to fight back with, instead the player uses the explosions from the enemy bombs to propel themselves upwards and hit the aircraft. Hitting the aircraft causes the tank to bounce off, allowing the player to hit more aircraft in order to rack up a combo. Each hit gives the player experience, and every time the player levels up, their fuel meter (which steadily depletes) completely refills and they are given a chance to get some upgrades. All the upgrades come in the form of different enemies that can appear and how frequently they do, allowing the player to get higher combos by increasing the amount of enemies.

439085.overview:
Insectonator is a 2D casual Shooter created using Flash and made by BGamesSite. The basic premise is that a backyard is filled with bugs (well, mostly) of various kinds, and the job is to exterminate them... at all costs. There’s only one person who can handle this high-caliber job - you.

Unlock and choose from an assortment of up to 26 different weapons (from the humble beginnings of a rock to the bazooka to the nuke) to exterminate 20 types of insects. Earn up to 28 achievements from accomplishing various tasks such as using certain classes of weaponry to kill the bugs, kill enough, miss enough, etc. Build up your arsenal of weaponry by completing these various achievements.

There are three modes of play: Annihilator, Killer, and Selectioner. The goal in Annihilator is to kill all enemies in the yard. The goal in Killer is eliminate specific insects, in a specific order. The goal in Selectioner is to exterminate a specific group and quantity of insects. With all modes of play, points are earned based on number of enemies killed at once, every bug killed, number of head-shots, and the current kill streak running.

439086.overview:
The I of It is a puzzle platformer Flash game developed and published by MiniClip.

Life wasn't the same after 't' left, so 'I' decided to hit the road and search for it. In this game, the player plays as the letter 'I'. They can move, but they cannot jump. However, they can enlarge and shrink.

439087.overview:
Into Space is an action game where the player controls a rocket and has to fly as high as they can while obtaining resources such as cash and gas to make that goal easier. When the player falls, either due to hull damage or no fuel, the player is taken to the shop where they can use their earned cash to upgrade the rocket in various fields.

The goal is to be able to get to the checkpoints, reaching the final one outside the Earth's atmosphere.

439094.overview:
Infectonator is a flash game developed by Toge Productions. It is a simulator game where you have to infect as many people as you can with a virus that turns humans into zombies.

Infectonator features a set of 13 levels where the goal is to place a virus among a crowd of people to turn all victims within range of the virus into flesh-eating zombies, creating a chain reaction wherein the zombies you created will go after uninfected people and turn them into zombies too. Ideally, you should place your virus where it'll infect a large number of people so your chain reaction can get a strong start. As the zombies roam around the room trying to spread the virus, they'll eventually die off and drop coins that can be collected to buy upgrades with; if all the zombies onscreen die and no one else got infected, the chain reaction ends (although some levels give you grenades that you can use to kill off any stubborn survivors that weren't killed by the virus). Once it does, you get to move on to the next level if you've killed enough people to meet the current level's quota; otherwise, if you fail to meet the quota, the game ends.

439095.overview:
Intrusion is a shooting platformer flash game developed by Vapgames and released on July 21, 2008.

In Intrusion, the player controls a super soldier who must fight through 5 levels of snowy mountains, industrial complexes and moving trains and battle their way through waves of soldiers, helicopters, and robots. Green flags can be found throughout levels and when walked over, they will act as a checkpoint. The player is given three lives and will take damage from enemies but can heal with health packs that can be found on the battlefield. If the player’s lives are depleted, the must start from the very beginning of the level they died on, unless they reach the halfpoint of a level, in which case they will spawn there as shown in the first level.

The player can earn score by killing enemies and collecting gold coins but can also earn bonus points for multi kills. The starting pistol in the game has unlimited ammo, but any other weapons picked up on the battlefield are likely to be more powerful, but only have limited ammo.

439115.overview:
Just like Pong, except you can shoot projectiles and there are a few surprises as the game progresses.

As of the 31st of January, 2018, this game is the most played game on Newgrounds.com, with 46,092,912 views.

439881.overview:
The Majesty of Colors takes place inside the dream world of an unknown narrator, who dreams to be a sea creature with three eyes and a tentacle. The player is able to control the tentacle using the mouse, and can interact with the people that pass above it.

Similar to I Wish I were the Moon, the goal of the game is to find five possible endings, all depending on the actions (or inactions) with the people above. Written narration during the game helps to understand the consequences of the actions and conveys the moment of awakening from the dream in the end of each game session, always depending on the chosen actions.

482466.overview: An action platform shooter set in snowy landscapes filled with mechanical enemies. Precise movement and shooting combine with physical interactions, enormous machines and elaborate boss battles.
